name: Gemini 3.6 Flash
short: Google's Flash (1M/65K, $1.50/$7.50) for coding/computer use; GPQA 93.4% and OSWorld-Verified 83%.
modalities: Text, image, audio, PDF in; text out
freeTierNote: Free tier available on Google AI Studio and OpenCode Zen with standard rate limits
standout: The computer-use Flash: it not only writes code but reliably drives real desktops and apps, at Flash-tier pricing.
tradeoff: Steady mid-tier card but no headline speciality beyond computer use — specialists in coding depth or reasoning sit nearby at Google.
notable: Medical imaging: a feature-based hybrid pipeline using Gemini 3.6 Flash reached 99.2% accuracy (387/390 lesions) on O-RADS risk stratification from free-text pelvic ultrasound reports — near-perfect agreement with expert consensus (weighted κ 1.00), the best of eight LLMs tested and well above the original clinical reports' 87.7% (arXiv:2608.23061).
